         **Review-Beispiele:**
            1. _Nick_, 05.10.2026, 1/5: "Misleading sign-up flow with ill-thought out training plan and use cases. If user showed they have certain health issues, they still offered with harmful exercises for their condition, and Support just advising user to consult their doctor. The company refuses to issue an immediate refund. You warned. Stay away."
            2. _Archie-Val Pangilinan_, 29.09.2026, 1/5: "I signed up and paid for this because I thought there would be kegel exercises program but there was none! The app is soooo slow. Waste of money"
